component.name: StarLite Image Patcher
component.summary: Patch FydeOS/openFyde images for Star Labs StarLite

description.p: Point-and-click front end for the openfyde-starlite inject script. Choose a FydeOS or OpenFyde .bin image. The patcher reads that image's release and kernel, then picks the accelerometer module built for that kernel. It does not replace the kernel. The result keeps accelerometer rotation, BlueZ instead of Floss, brightness-remember, lid-touch-guard, external-only, tablet-switch, power-sleep, verity re-seal, and the held Wi-Fi and TPM fixes.
The Flatpak UI runs the host patcher via flatpak-spawn --host because guestfish/losetup/verity cannot run reliably inside the sandbox. Requires the openfyde-starlite checkout on the host (v1).
